strings.gwipeConfirm:
⚠️ Full Google wipe:

• Egogola Play Store + Google Play services + Services Framework data.
• ⛔ OJJA kuyingizibwa mu Google accounts (olina okuddamu okuzigattako).
• Ebifaananyi byo ne apps zo tezikwatibwako.
• Ekyuma reboots automatically after.

Okakasa?
strings.logGwipeHead: 💣 Full Google wipe etandise — okugogola store + services, olwo okuddamu okutandika...

strings.hintLog: Buli kiragiro kizingiddwa mu kiseera ekiwedde — ekyuma tekiyinza nate ku freeze. Okuwandiika kukoma ku fayiro emu yokka: /data/adb/tricky_store/target.txt

strings.maintHint: Koona ku bbaatuuni yonna okulaga ennyonyola yaayo mu bujjuvu.
strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: ekebera keybox eriwo kati okusinziira ku Google's revocation list (CRL) era egezaako ensonda eziwera okutuusa lw'efuna keybox entuufu, nga erimu automatic backup n'okuddamu okutandika Google services. Eddukira ku buli taapu era yeetaaga yintaneeti (eddakiika 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox okuva ku network: ewanula keybox okuva mu tterekero entongole (GitHub) n’agitereka ku /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Yeetaaga yintaneeti era etwala eddakiika 1-3. Ekozesebwa nga smart fetch eremereddwa oba nga keybox yakyusibwa mu ngalo.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP okuzuula: kukebera modulo za Remote Key Provisioning eziriwo, okwekenneenya enkyusa ya satifikeeti y'okukakasa TEE, era eraga embeera y'ekintu kya KmInstallKeybox. Tekyuusa kintu kyonna — okulaba embeera y'ekyuma okwa bulijjo.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (okusoma kwokka): eraga Widevine ebiraga omutendera (L1/L3) okuva mu dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file okubeerawo, n'ebintu ebikwatagana n'enkola. Tewali kintu kyonna ky’akyusaamu n’akatono.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP okutereeza: adduka sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Etereeza ensonga z'okukakasa nga automatic pass eremereddwa. Buli misinde gikuba layini entegeerekeka ey’obuwanguzi/okulemererwa.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Okutereeza RKP mu bujjuvu: adduka sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh mujjuvu. Akwata kkeesi enzibu era etwala ekiseera ekiwanvu. Ekivaamu ekitegeerekeka obulungi kirabika ku nkomerero.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Okuzzaawo GMS: erongoosa Play Store ne Google services (GMS+GSF) data era n'eddamu okutandika ekyuma mu ngeri ey'otoma. For stubborn attestation only — tekikwatako ku bifaananyi byo oba fayiro zo.
strings.mdCertify: • Okukakasa okuzannya: kukebera embeera y'okukakasa satifikeeti RKP ey'ekyuma era n'azzaawo eby'obugagga by'okukakasa bwe kiba kyetaagisa. Tekwata ku data y'omukozesa.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER okuddaabiriza: kutereeza ensonga Google services framework (SOTER) ezikwata ku kukakasa ekyuma. Ekozesebwa ku byuma ebimu ebyesigama ku SOTER mu kifo kya Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Teeka PIF: adduka sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh amaanyi. Ekozesa engalo erongooseddwa (eya wano/ey'omulembe) era n'ezza obuggya fayiro za pif.prop/pif.json. Ekivaamu ekitegeerekeka obulungi kirabika mu log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: eraga embeera ya yingini etekeddwa, fayiro z'engalo (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), n'ebiwandiiko. Kebera yokka — tekyusa kintu kyonna.
strings.mdCanary: • Okulongoosa kwa Canary: kudduka sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Ereeta okufulumizibwa kwa Canary Engine okusembyeyo okukakasa okukwatagana ne satifikeeti ezikakatako RKP (February 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Okuzuula yingini: kukebera embeera ya TrickyStoreOSS (pid, logs), fayiro za keybox (active vs user), fingerprint y’ekyuma ekituufu vs spoofed, ebisumuluzo target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP. Okwolesebwa kw’okuzuula kwokka.
strings.hintKbSlots: Module eddukanya ebifo bibiri eby’ebisumuluzo: eby’olubereberye (ebitukuvu, ebitasangiddwangako) n’eby’okubiri (eby’okutereka). Tabu eno eraga ekifo ki ekikola, ekyusa eky'okwettanira, oba etumbula ekyokubiri okudda ku kisookerwako ku kusaba okutegeerekeka — n'okutereka n'ekiwandiiko ekijjuvu.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Okuzuula obulungi: kukebera okuyingiza ekisumuluzo TEE, empiso y'etterekero munda mu keystore2, embeera y'okusazaamu (CRL), okubikka ku lukalala lw'obukuumi n'embeera RKP. Okusoma kwokka — tekikyusa kintu kyonna.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Olukalala lw'obukuumi luddamu okuzimbibwa okuva ku buli app etekeddwako.
• Layer y'okukwatagana ne custom-ROM eddamu okukozesebwa.
• Ekisumuluzo ekikola kiddamu okukozesebwa.
• Google Play services ziddamu okutandika.

Tewali kintu kyonna esaziddwamu era ekisumuluzo ekisookerwako tekikwatibwako.

Continue?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Ebifo eby’ebisumuluzo: biraga embeera y’ebifo ebisookerwako n’eby’okubiri era n’ekyusakyusa eky’okwegomba wakati wabyo. Primary (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) bulijjo ekuumibwa era tesangulwako. Okutumbula secondary okudda ku primary kyetaagisa okukakasa mu bulambulukufu.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Tumbula ekifo ekyokubiri okutuuka ku primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml kifuuka ebirimu mu kifo ekisookerwako.
• Primary eriwo kati eterekebwa nga backup nga tennakyusibwa.
• Tewali kintu kyonna kisazibwamu — omulimu gukyusibwa.

Continue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Clear the secondary slot:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ejja kuggyibwawo.
• Ekifo ekisookerwako tekikwatibwako.

Continue?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (empya mu v3.17):

• Ekebera keybox eriwo kati okusinziira ku Google revocation list (CRL).
• Egezaako ensonda eziwera okutuusa nga keybox ennyonjo ezuuliddwa.
• Automatic backup + restarts Google services.

⚠️ Needs yintaneeti (eddakiika 1-3). Eeyongera?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Fetch keybox okuva ku internet:

• Ewanula keybox entongole n'agikakasa.
• Eteekeddwawo enkalakkalira (teddangamu ku boot).

⚠️ Yeetaaga internet (okutuuka ku ddakiika emu). Eeyongera?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Ddamu okugaba ebisumuluzo RKP:

• Tewali fayiro za data oba keybox zisazibwamu.
• Ddamu okutandika essimu oluvannyuma.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Okuddaabiriza mu bujjuvu:

• Okuddamu okugaba RKP + okuddamu okutandika Google empeereza.
• Ekyuma kiddamu okutandika mu ngeri ey'otoma (tewali kisangiddwa).

Continue?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Ddamu okutandika Google services:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — okuddamu okutandika yokka.
• Tewali kintu kyonna kisangiddwa era TOJJA kufuluma.
• Ekyuma kiddamu okutandika mu ngeri ey'otoma.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Force re-provision (Red Magic):

• Ku byuma ebibuusa amaaso keybox evuddemu.
• Ekola ne bwe kiba nti ebisumuluzo biramu.
• Tewali data esazibwamu.

Continue?
strings.confirmCertify:
Force Play Store certification:

• Egogola Store cache yokka — account yo tekwatibwako.
• Ddamu okutandika, olwo oggule Store.

Continue?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER okuddaabiriza:

• Eddamu okutandika empeereza ya vendor.soter.
• Egogola data ya seva SOTER yokka.

Weeyongere?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Siiga fingerprint (PIF):

• Ekyusa custom.pif.prop n'agiteeka mu kkubo lya yingini.
• Yeetaaga okuddamu okutandika oluvannyuma.

Continue?
strings.confirmCanary:
Update Canary fingerprint:

• Ewanula engalo ya Canary entongole eyasembyeyo okuva ku Google.
• Ekwataganya ekitundu ky'obukuumi + eddamu okutandika empeereza za Google (tewali kusiimuula).

⚠️ Yeetaaga yintaneeti (eddakiika 1-3). Eeyongera?
